title: Simulation data and analysis: effective screening length in crowded solutions of charged patchy macroions
description: Faunus inputs, Monte Carlo simulation results and Python analysis scripts for explicit- and implicit-ion simulations of charged patchy macroions (CPPM) at volume fraction 0.30. The data reproduce all figures and tables of the accompanying manuscript submitted to The Journal of Chemical Physics.
